context: A parent and child discuss a public-school transfer
purpose: Teach: 業種/勤め/往復/公立/進学/件数/位置づけ/合同

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さくら、今日学校から進学の資料もらってきたでしょ？ちょっと見せてくれる？
lines.en: Sakura, you got the school advancement materials today, right? Can you show me?
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, gentle but slightly probing inquiry

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、はい。先生にも色々伺ったんだけど、やっぱり公立中学校に転校したいなって思ってる。
lines.en: Yeah, here. I asked the teacher a lot too, and I really want to transfer to the public middle school.
lines.style: Hesitant teen voice, careful and a bit nervous

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 公立に？今の私立はお父さんの勤め先からも近いし、往復で一時間もかからないのよ？
lines.en: Public school? Your current private school is close to Dad's workplace, and the round trip takes less than an hour.
lines.style: Surprised concerned mother, questioning practical concerns

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもね、合同の説明会で聞いたら、公立でも進学実績の件数すごく多いんだって。
lines.en: But at the joint information session, I heard the public school has tons of advancement results too.
lines.style: Earnest teen making her case, slightly defensive

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふうん。でもうちの教育方針の中で、私立の位置づけって結構大事だったでしょ？
lines.en: Hmm. But within our education plan, the private school had a pretty important role, didn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful maternal voice, weighing options carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかってる。でも将来やりたい業種を考えたら、もっと色んな子と仲良くなりたいの。
lines.en: I know. But thinking about the industry I want to go into, I want to make friends with all kinds of kids.
lines.style: Heartfelt young teen, opening up sincerely

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そっか…言い訳じゃなくて、ちゃんと自分で考えたのね。お父さんとも話してみようか。
lines.en: I see... So it's not an excuse, you really thought it through yourself. Let's talk with Dad too.
lines.style: Softening understanding mother, accepting daughter's growth

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう、お母さん。日頃から応援してくれて、ほんとに感謝してる。
lines.en: Thanks, Mom. I'm really grateful you support me all the time.
lines.style: Relieved grateful teen, warm and sincere closing
